interfaces.name: ankle_screw
interfaces.what: Ø1.6 x 5.5 thread-forming pilot with Ø3.0 x 0.5 relief on a Ø5 boss — under the ankle’s Ø2.2 vertical foot screw at the same (x 50.0, y 4.502) axis (ankle part.py SCREW_X/Y)
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen’s mesh by cecad.meshfeatures.cylinders, 2026-09-02

interfaces.name: ankle_cradle
interfaces.what: R16.3 cylindrical seat about the ankle axis (y 22, z -6.223) on the x 32.9..34.15 / 65.85..67.1 ledges — the exact radius and bottom (-22.523) of the ankle’s under-hull — plus two through pockets x 34.0..39.2 / 60.8..66.0, y 31.563..35.763 that take the ankle’s +y blocks (0.1 mm fit)
interfaces.source: MEASURED: seat probes X/D (R16.3 at y10/16/22/28/34), pockets ZZ/U probes; ankle blocks from microduck-ankle-left part.py BLOCK_X

interfaces.name: roller_slot
interfaces.what: R16.5 relief band y 12.9..31.1 across the rib tops (0.2 mm over the seat) and two x 45..55 snap fingers rising to z -12.342 with 1.0 mm barbs facing each other — the clip-on roller drops between them
interfaces.source: MEASURED: rib tops -21.574 at y16 (R16.5); barbs/tabs from T/V/Lx probes

interfaces.name: sole_skirt
interfaces.what: lower body x 31.6..68.4 / y -9.9..39.9 (corners R3.45/4.89) — the zero-clearance plug for the sole’s cavity; rib bottoms sit on the sole floor (= sole outer floor + 2.000 mm), the flange overhangs the sole rim at z -18.342
interfaces.source: MEASURED equal on both meshes: foot outer = sole cavity to 0.01 mm (A/P/Q probes both parts)

record.frame: Pollen's mesh frame for foot_left.stl: x heel 30..toe 70, y -12..42, z up (-29.251..-12.342); the ankle axis is the x-line through (y 22.0, z -6.223). Same body and transform as ankle_left/sole_left, so their numbers line up 1:1.
